author: teteumac
body:
This PR removes 47 selected general monitor-element bookings from the base folders of cleaned AK4
  Calo, PF and PUPPI RECO jet DQM:

  - `JetMET/Jet/Cleanedak4CaloJets`: 15.
  - `JetMET/Jet/Cleanedak4PFJets`: 2.
  - `JetMET/Jet/Cleanedak4PFJetsPuppi`: 30.

  The cleanup uses existing jet-type and folder conditions. No new parameters, helpers, configuration
  changes, tests or documentation files are added. HGCAL-specific selections are excluded and left
  for a separate patch.

  Shared filling code, event/jet selection, axes and binning remain unchanged. PF Uncleaned, CHS,
  MiniAOD, scouting, cosmics and DiJet/ZJets bookings are preserved. Calo/PF MC clones with the same
  selected sources and folders receive the same cleanup.

  Five existing PUJetID ratio bookings in the harvester skip absent RECO inputs when a customized
  comparison uses the cleaned PUPPI folder. The default CHS comparison and other ratio bookings
  remain unchanged.

  The Calo scouting-only bookings and `JetArea_uncor`, and the selected PUPPI energy-fraction
  profiles and PUJetID discriminants, have no filling in their selected RECO branches. The three
  PUPPI Jet-ID efficiency profiles and two PF BX diagnostics have active filling code: their removal
  follows the selected monitoring reduction, not a claim that they are universally unfilled.

  Validation:

  - `CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-09-29-2300`, `el9_amd64_gcc14`.
  - Base SHA: `c490709683b8ec56386d5ba16b1e506d7f2f1420`.
  - Build, C++ formatting and `git diff --check` passed.
  - `DQM:@jetmet` and `HARVESTING:@jetmet` used the same 100 saved RECO events as the original-IB
  reference: run 403663, `Run3_2026`, `DB:Extended`, GlobalTag
  `161X_dataRun3_Prompt_frozen260520_v1`; CPU, 4 threads, 1 stream.
  - DQM and harvesting exited 0 with no FrameworkJobReport errors. Expanded configuration is byte-
  identical to the reference.
  - Strict full-JetMET comparison without numerical tolerance found exactly 47 expected removals, no
  unexpected additions/removals, and all 2,124 retained objects identical, including 2,062 histograms
  and their profile populations, statistics and flow bins.
  - Two synthetic consumer fixtures passed: 31 CHS ratios and 26 PUPPI ratios. Retained ratios
  preserve bin contents and errors, including flow bins. These are consumer checks, not reconstructed
  MiniAOD event validation.
  - Static review confirms unchanged booking arguments/order, filling functions and configurations.
  HGCAL selections remain unchanged.

  The independent test confirms the default RECO target paths; the worksheet's original cfg/ROOT
  remains unconfirmed. Functional coverage review for retiring Jet-ID/BX monitoring and broader
  unaffected-mode event/limited RelVal validation remain outstanding
title: [DQM] Remove selected general offline jet DQM
